reason: The budget caps and loop guard speak right to my fear, but I'm not running client work overnight on a pre-alpha tool built by one person. What Claude and Codex already schedule is good enough for us right now.
objection: If that one developer stops or a bug gets past the guard, my client repos and our agent quota are the ones that pay for it.
would_change_my_mind: A few agencies like mine running it on real client work for a couple of months, with proof the budget stop actually held.
